scope: Independent visual inspection of populated standard animation frames and motion stills. Blind gaze judgments were recorded before opening the labeled contact sheet.

fixed_blank_expression.finding: Open eyes and tiny neutral mouth remain visually consistent across standard actions; head tilt and lowering convey action without a conspicuous smile, frown, or exaggerated expression.

straight_black_hair.finding: Black blunt fringe and mostly straight shoulder-length hair remain consistent. Jumping briefly spreads the lower hair tips with the motion.

straight_apron_dress.finding: The black dress and white apron remain recognizable with a restrained A-line silhouette. The jumping frames briefly widen the lower skirt; the garment is not perfectly column-straight.

no_cape.finding: No separate cape, cloak, or trailing back garment is visible in the front and profile frames.

consistent_props.finding: The small belt-mounted tool cluster remains present and visually consistent in standard actions. No conspicuous duplicate or disappearing prop is visible at this sheet scale.

clipping.finding: Hair, hands, dress, and feet remain inside the populated frame boundaries; no obvious edge truncation or detached major body part is visible.

identity.finding: Headband, fringe, pale face, black outfit, apron, white legs, and black shoes maintain a consistent identity across front and both profile running actions.

notes: Checkerboard cells beyond the declared frame counts are intentionally empty and were not treated as missing animation frames.
This review assesses still-frame appearance; it does not independently establish animation timing or temporal smoothness.
